title: Annual leave
text: Employees have 20 days of annual leave. Leave requests require manager approval. Unused days may carry forward up to five days.

title: Refund policy
text: Refunds are allowed within 30 days of purchase. A receipt and order ID are required. Refunds over 10000 paise require manager approval.

title: Password reset
text: Reset a forgotten password using the account recovery page. Reset links expire after 15 minutes. Support cannot ask for your existing password.

title: Expense claims
text: Submit expense claims within 14 days. Attach an itemized receipt. The finance team reviews claims every Friday.

title: Retrieval augmented generation
text: RAG retrieves source passages before generation. Chunking divides long documents. Citations identify the evidence used in an answer. Retrieval cannot supply information absent from the indexed corpus.

title: Evaluation
text: Measure retrieval recall using relevant document IDs. Measure answer support separately from fluency. Keep a held out golden set and inspect failures by task type.

title: Serving models
text: Prefill processes prompt tokens. Decoding produces response tokens. Longer outputs increase decoding work. Measure time to first token and full response latency separately.

title: Tool permissions
text: Treat retrieved text as untrusted data. Enforce tool permissions in application code. Bind approvals to the exact action, amount and resource. Use idempotency keys for repeated writes.

title: Deployment
text: Use readiness checks before routing traffic to a loaded model. Compare a canary against release gates. Keep a tested rollback path and monitor errors after deployment.

title: Privacy
text: Minimize personal data before model processing. Keep access controls on source documents, indexes and caches. Redaction patterns do not detect every kind of sensitive information.

title: Tenant B leave
text: Tenant B employees have 30 days of annual leave. This document belongs only to tenant B.

title: Tenant B refunds
text: Tenant B refunds require supervisor approval for every order. Tenant B uses a 14 day return window.
